facts.content: Patient presents with a 3-day headache.
facts.source_text: CC: 3-day headache

facts.content: Patient has a global headache, right periorbital greater than the rest.
facts.source_text: HPI: Global HA, R periorbital > rest

facts.content: Headache is constant with fluctuating intensity and rated 8/10.
facts.source_text: constant w/ fluctuating intensity; 8/10

facts.content: Headache is dull with intermittent sharp pain and had a gradual onset at work.
facts.source_text: dull → intermittently sharp; gradual onset at work

facts.content: Headache is worse in the morning and has worsened over 3 days.
facts.source_text: worse next morning; worsening over 3 d

facts.content: Associated symptoms include photophobia, 'shooting lights' at onset, nausea, and difficulty focusing.
facts.source_text: Assoc: Photophobia; “shooting lights” at onset; nausea w/o emesis; difficulty focusing

facts.content: Denies vision loss, blurry vision, speech difficulty, limb weakness, head injury, fever, and rash.
facts.source_text: Denies: Vision loss/blurry vision, speech difficulty, limb weakness, head injury, fever, rash

facts.content: Patient has had prior headaches that usually resolve with ibuprofen.
facts.source_text: Prior HAs: Yes; usually resolve w/ ibuprofen

facts.content: Patient takes no regular medications but has used ibuprofen 3 tabs per day for 2 days with minimal relief.
facts.source_text: Meds: No regular; ibuprofen 3 tabs/day x2 d w/ minimal relief

facts.content: Patient has no known drug allergies.
facts.source_text: Allergies: NKDA

facts.content: Patient denies other medical problems.
facts.source_text: PMH: Denies other medical problems

facts.content: Mother and sister have migraines; mother's are frequent especially with season change, sister's are rare.
facts.source_text: FH: Mother + sister w/ migraines (mother frequent esp w/ season change; sister rare)

facts.content: Patient lives with three housemates and works in IT using screens heavily.
facts.source_text: Lives w/ 3 housemates; works in IT (heavy screen use)

facts.content: Patient wears glasses and has not had a recent eye exam.
facts.source_text: wears glasses; no recent eye exam

facts.content: Patient is a social smoker and consumes alcohol socially.
facts.source_text: social smoker; etOH socially

facts.content: Patient experiences mild work stress due to a new project.
facts.source_text: mild work stress (new project)

facts.content: There is a suspected migraine-type headache with photophobia, visual phenomena, and nausea.
facts.source_text: 1) Suspected migraine-type headache: 3 d, R periorbital predominant, photophobia + visual phenomena, nausea (no emesis), interferes w/ work; FHx supportive; no focal neuro sx, fever, or trauma; poor response to low-dose ibuprofen

facts.content: Optimize ibuprofen dosing or prescribe naproxen and may add paracetamol or codeine as needed.
facts.source_text: Analgesia: Optimize ibuprofen dosing (up to 2 tabs TID if continuing) OR prescribe naproxen; may add paracetamol or codeine PRN

facts.content: Keep a headache diary to track potential triggers.
facts.source_text: Headache diary; track potential triggers

facts.content: Follow-up in 1–2 weeks; consider prophylactic therapy if episodes become frequent.
facts.source_text: FU 1–2 wk; consider prophylactic therapy if episodes become frequent

facts.content: Patient advised to return or seek care if the headache worsens, or if there are vision changes, limb weakness, or feeling generally unwell.
facts.source_text: Safety-net: Return/seek care if worsening HA, vision problems, limb weakness, or generally unwell

facts.content: If ongoing eye strain, arrange a repeat eye test with optometry.
facts.source_text: If ongoing eye strain, arrange repeat eye test (optometry)
